description: This file defines a Perl module for the Coocook application, specifically a controller handling API endpoints. It sets up routing, handles a statistics request, and overrides the end method.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::API
classes.description: A controller class for handling API requests in the Coocook application.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Sets up the base chained route for API endpoints, setting the current view to 'Ajax'.

methods.name: statistics
methods.description: Handles GET and HEAD requests to retrieve statistics data from the database model and responds via AJAX.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Overrides the default end method to render views.
